name: Shuthelah
title: Descendant of Ephraim
summary: Shuthelah (also known as Shutelah) was a son of Ephraim and the founder of the Shuthelahite clan. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Numbers and 1 Chronicles as an important patriarch within the tribe of Ephraim. In 1 Chronicles, it is also told about another Shuthelah who was a descendant of the first one, and about a tragic event where some of Ephraim's sons were killed by men from Gath.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Ephraim's son
keyEvents.description: Shuthelah is recorded as one of Ephraim's sons and the founder of the Shuthelahite clan.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy of the Shuthelites at the Census
keyEvents.description: During the second census in the plains of Moab, the clan of the Shuthelites was counted as part of the tribe of Ephraim.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogical Record in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Shuthelah is mentioned in the extended genealogy for the tribe of Ephraim in 1 Chronicles, with his descendants listed.

keyEvents.title: Ephraim's Grief over His Sons
keyEvents.description: In connection with this family history, it is told that men from Gath killed some of Ephraim's descendants when they tried to steal their livestock, which caused great grief for Ephraim.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Ephraim as Part of the People of Israel
keyEvents.description: Shuthelah's descendants formed an important part of the tribe of Ephraim, which played a central role in Israel's history and settlement in the promised land.
